item.title: 156 westwood lane - Shaking house, 4th September
item.description:
We have become increasingly concerned about the significant vibrations affecting our property whenever the No. 51 bus passes the house, particularly during the evening periods when general traffic levels are lower. The effect is most noticeable in the front bedroom, where the movement is sufficiently pronounced that the room and structure can be felt shaking as the bus travels past.The severity and frequency of these vibrations are causing considerable concern for our household. We are particularly worried about the potential long-term impact on the structural integrity and stability of the property, as repeated exposure to such movement could, over time, contribute to damage or deterioration that may not be immediately visible. Given the extent of the vibration being experienced inside the house, we believe this matter warrants urgent investigation to determine the cause and to assess whether the condition of the road, vehicle movements, or other factors are contributing to an unacceptable level of disturbance and potential risk to our property.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Westwood Lane, Blackfen, Greater London

item.title: Resurfacing roads and lines, 4th September
item.description:
The roads in the Elms Estate need resurfacing. The roads are a disintegrating patchwork of sloppy repairs. Hever Gardens and Wellsmoor Road are especially bad. We were promised that when residents’ parking was introduced, future costs would stay in line with inflation but no more, yet they have increased by a massive 166% way over the inflation rate. Yet the very lines which are supposed to define where it is possible to park have in many places all but disappeared. However, while the road lines do need to be repainted this should be done only after the road has been properly resurfaced. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hever Gardens, Bickley, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
